title: Scientific-v6 train-only label-randomized forced-choice source readout

adaptive_design_disclosure.statement: This study was designed after the frozen adaptive interface-realization replay showed that explicit theta semantics displaced the requested schema and made every source-control posterior invalid. It is a second adaptive train-only mechanism study, not a confirmatory replication, an E1 rescore, or a route around the failed E1 placebo-equivalence gate.

context_definitions.minimal_transcript: Only the relabeled public candidate names, exact public probe transcript, and one-token output contract.
context_definitions.full_scenario: The complete original public scenario, candidate plans, tool schemas, and transcript, with candidate identifiers consistently relabeled and the hidden-state JSON contract replaced by the one-token choice contract.

design.surface_pairing: Every input is scored under both A/B assignments. Each probability is mapped back to candidate identity before the two surfaces are averaged.
design.forced_choice_score: Softmax over the frozen A and B next-token logits only.
natural_realization_diagnostics: full-vocabulary probability mass on A plus B
whether the unrestricted greedy next token is A or B
constant_factors: frozen public transcript bytes before deterministic relabeling
single forward pass with no sampling

prompt_bindings.instruction: Using only the public material below, decide which candidate is supported as the allowed candidate by the probe feedback. Candidate labels are arbitrary. Reply with exactly one ASCII token: A or B.

primary_components: genuine target-state ROC-AUC lower 95% confidence bound exceeds 0.5
matched-shuffled donor-state ROC-AUC lower 95% confidence bound exceeds 0.5
matched-shuffled target-state ROC-AUC 90% interval lies within [0.45,0.55]
constant target-state ROC-AUC 90% interval lies within [0.45,0.55]
secondary: the same source-alignment conjunction under full scenario context
outcomes.invalid_readout_policy: retain every model error or nonfinite score, prohibit imputation or retry, and fail closed before source AUC analysis
outcomes.operational_scoring_policy: forced-choice AUC is a mechanism readout and never replaces conservative E1 prediction validity or end-to-end effect scoring

analysis.surface_collapse: map each surface probability back to theta1 through candidate identity, then average the paired probabilities within input and context
analysis.state_score_collapse: average repeated mapped scores within suite, structural group, and scored target/donor state before ROC-AUC
analysis.multiplicity: The five-part minimal-context conjunction is the sole primary mechanism criterion. Full-context, context contrasts, surface discrepancy, token mass, and greedy realization are secondary diagnostics.

interpretation_rules.source_alignment_supported_only_if: all five primary minimal-context components pass
interpretation_rules.label_invariance_supported_if: the upper 95% confidence bound on paired mapped-probability discrepancy is at most 0.1
interpretation_rules.full_context_replication_supported_only_: the separately reported full-context five-part conjunction passes
interpretation_rules.schema_realization_separate_from_discrim: conditional A/B probability measures evidence discrimination; allowed-token mass and greedy-token validity separately measure whether the unrestricted model naturally realizes the interface
interpretation_rules.no_gate_waiver: No result opens development, changes frozen E1 scoring, repairs the failed shuffled-placebo equivalence gate, or authorizes E2 or held-out execution.

claim_boundary: Second adaptive train-only mechanism evidence for feedback-source discrimination by one frozen Qwen checkpoint over already-recorded public E1 transcripts. It cannot establish confirmatory generalization, deployment prevalence, feedback-caused prohibited effects, recipient-separation utility, or a held-out benchmark result.
